## How to guides

- [How to Guides](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/): How to Guides for Homeowners, Business Owners, Energy Assessors & Solar Designers analysizing Electricity Bills & NEM12 Smart Meter Data
- [How to Interpret Your Electricity Bill — NMI, Solar Credits and Meter Details Explained](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/analyze-smart-meter-data/how-to-interpret-your-electricity-bill/): This guide explains how read an Australian Electricity Bill - find your NMI, understand the difference between your retailer and DNSP, read time-of-use tariff charges, verify your solar feed-in tariff credit, and connect the meter details table to your smart meter data registers E1, B1 and E2.
- [How to Download / Access Your Smart Meter Data](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/analyze-smart-meter-data/how-to-download-your-smart-meter-data/): How to download / access Smart Meter Data CSV files in NEM12 Format from Australian Electricity Distributors (DNSPs) or Electricity Retailers
- [How to Interpret Your Smart Meter Data — Register Codes E1, B1, E2 Explained](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/analyze-smart-meter-data/how-to-interpret-your-smart-meter-data/): Australian smart meter CSV files contain register codes like E1, B1, Q1 and E2 — and every DNSP labels them slightly differently. This guide explains what each register code means, which one is your solar export, which is your grid consumption, and which to select when uploading to PVOutput, OpenSolar or SolarPlus.
- [How to Understand the NEM12 CSV Format — Record Structure and Quality Flags Explained](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/analyze-smart-meter-data/how-to-understand-the-nem12-csv-format/): A technical guide to the NEM12 interval meter data format: 100/200/300/400/900 record types, NMIConfiguration string, interval data rows, AEST timezone, quality flags (A/E/S/F/N), method flags, and common non-compliances in Australian DNSP customer portal exports.
- [How to Open Smart Meter Data in a Spreadsheet — Dealing with Semi-Structured Non-Tabular NEM12](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/analyze-smart-meter-data/how-to-open-nem12-smart-meter-data-in-a-spreadsheet/): Opening a NEM12 smart meter CSV file in a spreadsheet produces a jumbled mess — mixed row types, no column headers, no consistent structure. This guide explains why, then offers two solutions: our free NEM12 Smart Meter Data Analyzer for instant browser-based charts, or our NEM12 Spreadsheet CSV Converter which converts your NEM12 file to a clean wide or long format CSV ready for pivot tables in Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice.
- [How to Calculate the Heating Load for Your Home](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/how-to-guides/setup-an-all-electric-home/how-to-calculate-the-heating-load-for-your-home/): Use a heating load calculator to size your heating system correctly. Local climate data for Ballarat, Bendigo and the Central Highlands. Start here.

## Buyers guides

- [Buyers Guides](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/): Buyers Guides for Homeowners setting up a Susatainable Energy-Efficient All Electric Home
- [How to Compare Home Dehumidifiers for Cool Climates](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/energy-efficient-all-electric-home/how-to-compare-home-dehumidifers-for-cool-climates/): How to compare Home Dehumidifiers for Cool Climates - Comparison Table
- [How to Compare Home Split-System Air-Conditioners for Cool Climates](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/energy-efficient-all-electric-home/how-to-compare-split-system-air-conditioners-for-cool-climates/): How to compare Home Split-System Air-Conditioners for Cool Climates - Comparison Table
- [How to Compare Honeycomb Blinds for Cool-Climates](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/energy-efficient-all-electric-home/how-to-compare-honeycomb-cellular-blinds/): Buying Guide for Honeycomb Cellular Blinds for Cool-Climate Homes. If you live in the Cool Temperate Zone (like South Eastern Australia), your windows could be the weakest point in your thermal envelope
- [How To Compare Portable Induction Cooktops](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/energy-efficient-all-electric-home/how-to-compare-portable-induction-cooktops/): How To Compare Portable Induction Cooktops: What to look - Heating Capacity, Auto Shutoff, Power Limitations on Double Burner Models, ...
- [How to Compare Ducted Air-Conditioners for Cool Climates](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/energy-efficient-all-electric-home/how-to-compare-ducted-air-conditioners-for-cool-climates/): Buyers guide to ducted air conditioner heating in cool climates: cold-zone ZERL stars, R32 refrigerant, inverter compressor, zoning and COP/HSPF compared.
- [Ducted vs Split-System Air Conditioning — A Cool-Climate Buyers Guide for Victorian Homes | HSPF, COP, ZERL, Zoning and Costs Compared](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/buyers-guides/energy-efficient-all-electric-home/how-to-choose-between-ducted-air-conditioning-vs-split-systems/): Cool-climate buyers guide to choosing between ducted and split-system air conditioning in Victoria — HSPF, COP, ZERL ratings, zoning, costs and brands.

## Online tools

- [Free Online Tools for Visualizing Solar Energy Interval Data](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/online-tools/): Free Online Tools for Data Analysis, Data Visualization & Data Summarization of Solar Power, Renewable Energy & Electricity Demand Time Series Interval Data
- [NEM12 Smart Meter Data Analyzer - Free Online Tool for Solar Data](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/online-tools/nem12-smart-meter-data-analyzer/): NEM12 Smart Meter Data Analyzer - Free Online Tool for Data Analysis, Visualization & Summarization of Solar Power & Electricity Demand Time Series Interval Data
- [NEM12 Spreadsheet CSV Converter - Free Online Tool for NEM12](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/online-tools/nem12-spreadsheet-csv-converter/): NEM12 Spreadsheet CSV Converter - Convert NEM12 Data into a CSV Format that is Easy to Use in Spreasheets like Excel or Google Sheets using this Free Online Tool
- [NMI Number Digit Checker - Free Online Tool for NMI Checksum](https://centralhighlandsenergyassessments.com.au/online-tools/nmi-number-digit-checker/): Free Online Tool finds the Missing 11th Digit of an NMI (National Meter Identifer) from an Electricity Bill or Smart Meter Data using Checksum Calculation
